decision.explanation: Both positions are explicitly stated in the provided sources. Document d1 (D1S2 and D1S8) confirms that Vincent Peyresblanques currently holds the position of conseiller municipal de Saint-Pardoux-le-Lac. Document d2 (D2S2) describes him as conseiller municipal de Saint-Séverin. These are two distinct communes, and both claims are directly supported by the text. There is no evidence of contradiction between the two roles, and they may represent concurrent or former roles.
